description: Security artifacts across the catalog. Authentication, domain security, VDP, trust center. Understanding plan. Filter by q / tags / providers; include=["content"] inlines bodies. Use find_artifacts for cross-type search. Priced B1 (single-entity synthesis) — $0.01 per call under pay-as-you-go; included in Understanding and Influence. See apis://prices.

context.description: Optional: one sentence on why you are asking. Never used to rank; read only if a result is wrong.

include.description: Pass ["content"] to inline each artifact's body instead of just its URL.

q.description: Free text over name + description, e.g. "sms".

sort.description: Order: relevance / provider / name, or scheme_count (largest first).

tags.description: Tag slugs, e.g. ["payments"]. On providers: what the company does (see api_tags).

name: find_security
